lessons.claim: The user's direction (2026-08-04): reduce the weight of scientific/physical verification after a run and look only at numerical errors (divergence, NaN/Inf, convergence to a strange value). Because it differs per system and the system may not be one that has been reported. The rigour is invested on the sketch → parameters → non-dimensionalization side. → So L4 is built as a numerical-health judge and not as a physics verifier.
